run.code_revision_scope: HEAD revision only; does not identify uncommitted working-tree changes

split.method: chronological 70/30 split of distinct baseline timestamps, per service

label_assumptions.assumed_normal_baseline: Chronological baseline evaluation rows are assumed normal; labels are not independently reviewed.
label_assumptions.synthetic_controls: Generated bounded-noise controls are assumed normal.
label_assumptions.synthetic_positives: Injected point and episode anomalies are labeled positive by construction, not by independent operational review.

unavailable_sample_rules.missing_observation: unavailable; excluded from every method's metrics
unavailable_sample_rules.invalid_observation: unavailable; excluded from every method's metrics
unavailable_sample_rules.reason: The shared F.28 evaluator's eligibility status is used for all methods; unavailable observations are never normal.

isolation_forest.fit_scope: per service on training timestamps only

direction_aware_mad.prediction_rule: anomaly if any informational deviation or actionable candidate
direction_aware_mad.actionability_rule: report actionable candidates separately; do not use them as the shared point-anomaly prediction
direction_aware_mad.fit_scope: per service on training timestamps only

hybrid.identity: experimental union; not integrated in runtime
hybrid.prediction_rule: Isolation Forest anomaly OR direction-aware MAD anomaly
hybrid.fit_scope: per service; component models use same training rows

episode_delay_contract.detection: first predicted anomaly at or after onset
episode_delay_contract.aggregation: mean over detected episodes only; missed episodes remain listed with null delay and are counted separately

limitations: All labels are synthetic or assumed normal; no independently verified operational labels are present.
Results compare method behavior on this fixture only and do not establish production detection quality.
The hybrid is an experimental union and is not integrated in runtime.
Baseline split is temporal within the same services, not service-transfer validation.
Unavailable sample counts cover missing/invalid F.28 observations; stale/future telemetry episodes are not modeled in this dataset.
Episode delay is defined only for generated timestamped episodes and is not incident response latency.
